ptz.name: Move camera
ptz.description: Move a PTZ camera of this integration (same fields as onvif.ptz).

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: 0.01-1 like ONVIF, or 1-8 for the camera scale.

continuous_duration.name: Duration
continuous_duration.description: Seconds the movement runs before it is stopped.

ptz_home.name: Go to home position
ptz_home.description: Move a camera of this integration to its home position.

ptz_not_configured.message: This camera has no PTZ configuration. Add it in the RTSP Camera Manager panel.

ptz_action_unsupported.message: The camera does not know the action {action}.

ptz_action_missing.message: Give a direction (pan/tilt/zoom), a preset, move_mode: Stop or an action.

ptz_preset_missing.message: Give the number of the preset.

ptz_unknown_camera.message: {entity_id} is not a camera of RTSP Camera Manager.

user.title: RTSP Camera Manager
user.description: Cameras are added in the add-on panel: open RTSP Cameras and press Add camera. This integration reads the JSON file the add-on writes, so every camera becomes a camera entity.

data_description.cameras_file: A relative path is resolved inside your Home Assistant configuration directory; the folder is created automatically when it does not exist yet.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the file is checked for added, changed or removed cameras.

error.invalid_path: Enter the path of the camera file.
error.cannot_create: The folder for this file could not be created, check the path and the permissions.
